author: ChemicalxNeon
body:
• Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed)
    My current ingame-name is ChemicalxNeon
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
    The account was suspended for "No-slow / Anti KB". I am not quite sure what No-Slow is but I know that Anti-KB is some sort of hack.
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.
    I gave this account to my friend following guidelines which he broke so he got my account banned on lots of servers including this one. I take full responsibility for my account and therefore apologise for any inconvenience caused. He claims that he was "lagging" but I can't confirm. Again, I am so sorry for any problems and I hope you take my response with sincerity not automatic :).

    With all respect,
    ChemicalxNeon

title: [Appeal] ChemicalxNeon

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
I will appeal you. Please be more responsible with your account in the future: if it happens to occur again, you will not have a chance of appealing. Be selective of who you loan your account to.


Regards,
ViceWatercolour.
